_comment: NOT-MUSIC GATE. Málaga Live is a LIVE MUSIC site, but several venues we track publish their WHOLE programme — Auditorio Municipal de Benalmádena (operabenalmadena / tickets.oneboxtds.com) and Marenostrum Castle Park (marenostrumfuengirola.com) list theatre, dance, comedy, magic and children's shows next to the concerts, and the weekly LLM sweep takes the lot. Deleting such a row from the calendar does NOT hold: the next sweep re-adds it from the same venue page. So exclusions live here and are applied by build_site.py on EVERY build, as a gate running BEFORE the phantom / Fever-unbuyable / receipt gates. Matching is on the normalised act name (lowercase, accents stripped) and is a SUBSTRING test. IMPORTANT: set 'venue' whenever the phrase could belong to a real act somewhere else — a personal name ('David Navarro', 'José Tejada') or a common phrase ('La Granja') must be scoped to the venue, or a genuine gig elsewhere would be silently dropped. Omit 'venue' only for names distinctive enough to be safe anywhere. NOT blocked, deliberately: CABARET 2.0 at the same Benalmádena venue IS live music (Sofia 2026-07-29). This gate's drops appear in the build log's [gate] block. NOTE (2026-08-04): this file is now shipped by the canonical deploy-site.bat (added to its Website scp list), so a normal deploy applies any edit here — no separate genre-fix bat needed. This gate also carries OWNER CONTENT-POLICY removals (e.g. 'love of lesbian', DLR 2026-08-04), not only not-music rows; the log prefix 'not live music' is cosmetic for those. STANDING INSTRUCTION (Sofia, 2026-08-24): do NOT wait for a non-music show to appear on the site or in a reel before acting. Whenever comedy, theatre, a clown/children's show, magic, dance or any other non-music event is spotted on a tracked venue's programme, TELL SOFIA IMMEDIATELY so it can be added here in advance - she cannot know about shows she has never seen. Pre-loading beats reacting: a reactive block only helps after the thing has already been published.

PHANTOM EVENT, removed 2026-08-27 - NOT a genre judgement. The site listed 'Reyes de Luna' at the Auditorio Municipal de Benalmadena on 27/08/2026 and 'Reyes de Luna (2a noche)' on 28/08/2026, both linking to tickets.oneboxtds.com/operabenalmadena/events/59179. NEITHER IS REAL. Checked in a browser on 27/08/2026: event 59179 does not resolve at all - the ticketer redirects it to the bare events catalogue - and 'Reyes de Luna' appears NOWHERE in the venue's forward programme, which the ticketer lists continuously from 28 Aug to 3 Oct 2026. The real booking for 28/08/2026 at that venue, 22:00, is 'JOSE TEJADA HIPNOMAGIA' (confirmed on the event's own poster art), which this file already blocks as non-music via 'hipnomagia' and 'jose tejada'. So the correct state for both nights is EMPTY. HOW IT GOT THROUGH, recorded honestly: 'reyes de luna' is not in operabenalmadena's acts in venue_event_map.json, and that venue is complete:true with the gate armed, so phantom_reason() WOULD have dropped it - until 2026-08-25, when Claude made phantom_reason() honour the venue's 'verify_only' flag. That change was made for a real reason (the same gate had deleted a genuine Starlite headliner, Solea Morente, on 15 Jul) but it removed the only thing catching this. The proper fix is for verify_only to REPORT an unverified event into the audit instead of silently passing it; until that exists, this entry is the stopgap. Scoped to venue: 'Reyes de Luna' is a plausible name for a real touring act, so an unscoped rule could delete genuine gigs elsewhere. LIFT THIS ENTRY if the venue ever genuinely books them - check the ticketer first. Kept in THIS file because it is the only removal lever that reaches the box: ticket_link_drops.json is box-owned and excluded from the ops_sync rsync.

STALE-DATE PHANTOM, removed 2026-08-25 - NOT a genre judgement. 'Banda Municipal: El Baul de los 70 con Serafin Zubiri', Plaza del Ajedrez, Estepona, was listed for 25/08/2026 and went out as that day's reel. IT IS NOT HAPPENING. The concert was real but took place on SUNDAY 25 AUGUST 2024: cultura.estepona.es/zubiri-banda-musica-el-baul-de-los-70/ is a 2024 article (published_time 2024-08-21, body says 'este domingo, 25 de agosto de 2024', poster file 240825_Concierto-Serafin-Zubiri.jpg) and 25 Aug 2024 was a Sunday while 25 Aug 2026 is a Tuesday. The sweep read a two-year-old archive page, took the day and month, and stamped the CURRENT year on it. Confirmed absent from the council's live agenda (ayuntamiento.estepona.es/agenda) on 25/08/2026, which is why Sofia found the link led to no such band. Blocked on the TITLE with no date or venue scope ON PURPOSE: the calendar row's venue reads 'Plaza del Ajedrez' rather than anything containing 'estepona', so a venue scope would have silently failed to match and left the phantom live - and leaving a non-existent concert on the site is far worse than over-blocking a show title that is not currently programmed. LIFT THIS ENTRY if the Banda Municipal genuinely revives the programme, after checking the YEAR on the source page.

STANDING RULE, not a one-off show. Sofia 2026-08-24: 'karaoke never counts'. Karaoke is the audience singing to backing tracks, not a live-music booking, so it is never a listing and never a reel. Deliberately UNSCOPED and deliberately a single common word so it catches the whole category wherever it appears - the trigger case was 'Ciao Mare - Italia Karaoke Show' at La Cochera Cabaret (3 Nov 2026), which the venue itself tags MUSICA. Substring matching means this also catches live-band karaoke billed as 'rockaraoke', which is still karaoke. This is the ONLY broad category rule in the file: every other entry names a specific show, because a broad rule can delete real gigs. It is safe here only because no touring act is billed with 'karaoke' in its name.
